name: Papal Guardsmen

abilities.name: Spear Wall
abilities.text: The unit moves into close wall formation.

attributes.name: Expert Charge Defence
attributes.text: This unit’s melee attack and damage are increased against charging enemies.

attributes.name: Disciplined
attributes.text: This unit does not suffer a morale penalty when the general dies. It can also rally after routing more often.

attributes.name: Encourage
attributes.text: This unit provides a morale bonus to nearby allies.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Immune to Fear
attributes.text: This unit is immune to the fear effects of scary units.

short: These men ensure the Holy Father is protected from those who would do him harm.
history: In AD768, when Stephen III was elected Pope during a period of political instability, Byzantine Roman soldiers were in attendance in order to discourage subterfuge and the open violence that had broken out between the candidates. After the ceremony, Stephen was escorted to the Lateran Palace under military protection, whilst throughout Rome his supporters began viciously attacking his opponents. Rather than being a powerless observer, it is thought that Stephen revelled in the destruction of his rivals; Constantine - his rival or 'anti-Pope' - was first beaten and imprisoned, then left in the street to die whilst his bishop had his tongue removed. Clearly, the Papal States were developing into a vicious, power-hungry, absolute monarchy. As a result, the Pope needed constant protection from enemies both within and without and most candidates ruled for only a few short years.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
